about_the_game:
About This Game

Welcome to Epic Survivors, a thrilling, fast-paced action roguelite where you'll face endless swarms of thousands of simultaneous enemies (end-game). Choose your hero from a diverse roster, each armed with a unique primary weapon and two powerful active abilities. Collect and strategically combine up to five additional random weapons each run to create devastating synergies and dominate the battlefield.

THOUSANDS OF SIMULTANEOUS ENEMIES

Battle overwhelming hordes featuring diverse and deadly attack patterns—leaping, charging, projectile-firing, and many more. Test your reflexes and adaptability against enemies designed to keep you on your toes.

INSANE BOSS ENCOUNTERS

Face off against massive, challenging bosses, each with distinctive attack patterns and mechanics. These epic battles will push your movement and abilities to their limits. Each 15-20 minute run will have 2-3 mini-bosses, and an End Game Boss to finish!

DYNAMIC EVENTS & EPIC REWARDS

Survive thrilling, event-driven challenges like hold-the-area missions, timed objectives, and intense scenarios offering epic rewards. Every run presents unique trials that require quick thinking and fast reflexes.

LEGENDARY HEROES

Unlock and master multiple legendary heroes, each with distinct weapons and two unique active abilities. Find the perfect hero to match your playstyle or explore new strategies each run. Aiming for 2-3 before first demo, and more to come shortly after.

EXPLOSIVE WEAPON SYNERGIES

Collect up to five additional random weapons per run from a pool of 15+ initial weapons, building powerful, game-changing combinations. Discover synergies, making each run uniquely satisfying and strategically deep. Each level up is a choice of 3 new weapons, passives, or upgrade to an existing one.

BULLET HEAVEN AND HELL

You are the Bullet Hell of your foes, emitting hundreds or thousands of projectiles and attacks per minute! But watch out, some events and enemies can turn the tables into your own personal Bullet Hell to survive! 

ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY

Epic Survivors offers immense replay value with continuous unlocks, new heroes, powerful weapons, and diverse gameplay events. Each session is a fresh and thrilling experience, promising endless hours of action.

STRATEGIC CHAOS

Balance fast reflexes and careful decision-making as difficulty ramps up. Master the chaos by choosing the right weapons, managing resources, and adapting swiftly to survive longer.

Do you have what it takes to endure the swarm and rise as an Epic Survivor?

Thank You to Our Community Epic Survivors is developed by a passionate indie team dedicated to bringing thrilling gameplay experiences. Your support, feedback, and enthusiasm drive our game forward—thank you for helping us shape Epic Survivors!

content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes mature content and may not be suitable for all audiences or appropriate for viewing at work:

Violence: The game features intense, action-packed gameplay where players fend off hordes of enemies. Combat results in pixel-based, stylized depictions of blood. Despite the simplified, retro-style graphics, these scenes are frequent and are a core part of the gameplay experience.

Fantastical Themes: While the game includes combat against fantastical creatures and supernatural scenarios, these are presented in a pixel art style that does not depict realistic violence.

Please note that this game does not contain any sexual content, drug use, or depictions of self-harm. The content warning is primarily for the frequent and stylized violence integral to gameplay.
